Assistant B is correct and Assistant A is not.

By inclusion-exclusion, P(blue or green) = P(blue) + P(green) − P(both) = 58% + 45% − 22% = 81%. So P(neither) = 100% − 81% = 19%.

Assistant B applies this formula, shows each step, and reaches 19%.

Assistant A gives 0.78, which would result from subtracting only the overlap (1 − 0.22). That ignores the 58% and 45% figures entirely. Its answer is wrong and offers no reasoning to check.

[[B]]
